lines.q: T rex lived closer in time to which of these?
lines.a: Us humans! Stegosaurus was gone about eighty million years before T rex showed up.

lines.q: When was the fax machine first patented?
lines.a: Eighteen forty-three! That's before the telephone even existed.

lines.q: What was the first toy ever advertised on TV?
lines.a: Mister Potato Head, in nineteen fifty-two! The first kits didn't even come with a potato.

lines.q: Last one. How long was the Eiffel Tower meant to stand?
lines.a: Just twenty years! Radio saved it from being torn down. Paris almost lost it!
